testCases.title: Open Login and check the email field
testCases.objective: The Email field is visible, labelled and accepts focus; the page is not blank.
testCases.description: Target: Patient Manager. Route: /login. Source control/section: userName. This is a manual navigation/visibility definition, not a recorded pass result.
testCases.preconditions: Use a synthetic-data test company and a permitted Patient Manager account. Enable the required sidebar modules and dashboard widgets. Seed a synthetic patient, appointment, invoice, transaction or referral when the case follows a record link. Use existing UI-generated links to supply identifiers; never enter placeholder IDs literally. Do not use production patient or payment data.

steps.action: Sign out or open a private browser in the Patient Manager test environment.
steps.expected: No authenticated patient/company page is displayed.

steps.action: Open the application Login link or /login in this signed-out browser.
steps.expected: The Login form loads without 404, blank content or a server error.

steps.action: Open the Login link in a signed-out browser.
steps.expected: The Email field is visible, labelled and accepts focus; the page is not blank.

steps.action: Refresh the Login page once without submitting credentials.
steps.expected: The Login page and its input controls remain visible and usable.
